title: OpenCode Data Breach Exposes API Keys Linked to Third-Party Services
content_md: OpenCode has reported a security breach affecting 1.4% of its Console users, which it attributes to a “large-scale distillation attack.” The company said the affected accounts belong to a subset of users who had connected external providers.
